description: A self-contained Python module for classifying bear movement states ('moving', 'stationary', 'unknown') based on detection data within a temporal window. Includes features for grouping detections, calculating distances with different metrics, smoothing statuses, and a demo with synthetic data.

classes.name: Detection
classes.description: Represents a single bear detection at a specific timestamp with spatial coordinates and optional pose data.

methods.name: float _euclidean(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Calculates Euclidean distance between two 2D points.

methods.name: float _haversine_like(a: Tuple[float, float], b: Tuple[float, float])
methods.description: Calculates a haversine-like distance assuming coordinates are latitude and longitude in degrees.

methods.name: Callable[[Tuple[float,float],Tuple[float,float]],float] _get_metric(metric: str)
methods.description: Resolves the distance metric function based on a string input ('euclidean' or 'haversine_like').

methods.name: Dict[str,List[Detection]] _build_index_by_bear(detections: Iterable[Detection])
methods.description: Groups detections by bear_id and sorts each group by timestamp.

methods.name: Tuple[int,int] _bounds_for_time_window(timestamps: List[float], center_t: float, window: float)
methods.description: Uses binary search to find index bounds of timestamps within the ±window_seconds interval.

methods.name: Optional[float] _min_neighbor_distance_for_index( positions: List[Tuple[float, float]], timestamps: List[float], idx: int, window_seconds: float, dist_fn: Callable[[Tuple[float, float], Tuple[float, float]], float], )
methods.description: Computes the minimum distance from a given detection to neighbors within the time window, excluding itself.

methods.name: Tuple[float,float] _safe_tuple(x: float, y: float)
methods.description: Converts x,y coordinates to a tuple of floats, handling errors.

methods.name: List[Tuple[float,float]] _basic_smooth_positions(positions: List[Tuple[float, float]])
methods.description: Applies a simple moving average smoothing to position sequences.

methods.name: List[dict] classify_movements( detections: List[Detection], window_seconds: float = 10.0, distance_threshold: float = 5.0, metric: str = "euclidean", apply_smoothing: bool = False, )
methods.description: Classifies each detection as 'moving', 'stationary', or 'unknown' based on neighboring detections within a time window and distance threshold.

methods.name: Dict[str,List[Detection]] build_index_by_bear(detections: List[Detection])
methods.description: Public helper to group detection data by bear_id.

methods.name: List[dict] smooth_statuses( per_bear_results: List[dict], min_consensus: int = 2, )
methods.description: Post-processes movement statuses to smooth out isolated classification spikes using neighbor consensus.

methods.name: None _demo()
methods.description: Demonstrates classification with synthetic data for two bears and prints results.
